title: Prima
paper_title: Learning Neuroimaging Models from Health System-Scale Data
core_mech: Prima 的核心链路是 32×32×4 子体积 VQ-VAE token、sequence ViT、study ViT，再以神经放射报告做 CLIP 对齐。
core_mech_en: Hierarchical clinical brain MRI study foundation model chaining 32×32×4 sub-volume VQ-VAE tokenization, a sequence-level ViT, and a study-level ViT aligned with radiology reports.
input_desc: 一个真实脑 MRI study 中的多序列 3D 体积、序列名称/描述与配对报告
input_en: Complete clinical brain MRI study (multiple heterogeneous 3D sequences + sequence metadata) + paired neuroradiology report
output_desc: 完整检查级 embedding、零样本相似度及冻结特征上的 52 任务 MLP 预测
output_en: Study-level multimodal embedding supporting zero-shot retrieval and 52 neurological diagnostic/triage MLP probes
gaps: The original Prima implementation is linked and pinned; its scan/series representation and complete training/inference protocol are not implemented locally.
